TextElement.Str:
AutoGuard automates AdGuard to bring together VPN and ad blocking on non-rooted Android devices

There's barely any space here, so more info at the project page on GitHub


Created by Omegaplex

Legacy mode

Enable if you're using AdGuard v3.6.11 or below. This mode doesn't work with AdGuard v4.0 and above.

AdGuard automation password

Allows this app to control proxy settings of AdGuard. You can find it in Settings → General → Advanced → Automation. Copy the password and paste here.

Inbound proxy port

You need to enable the inbound proxy server in your VPN app and enter the server port here. (How?)

When you connect to the VPN, the proxy will be started and AdGuard will filter its traffic.

Quiet mode

Don't show pop-up messages (toasts) at the bottom of the screen when you connect to or disconnect from a proxy server.

Inbound proxy type

Enable the inbound proxy server in your VPN app and enter the server type here. (How?)

When you connect to the VPN, the proxy will be started and AdGuard will filter its traffic.

VPN app as a VPN tunnel (root)

AutoGuard will check your device's VPN status (enabled or disabled) instead of checking, if the port %PORT is available. Useful only if your VPN client cannot work as a proxy (only as a VPN) but still supports inbound proxy.

Configure AdGuard in Automatic proxy mode to integrate with such apps (root required).
Hint: click on the setting name to show its description

Hi!

This small app will help you integrate AdGuard with various VPN clients, so think of it as advanced AdGuard + AdGuard VPN Integrated mode.

Only those VPN apps are supported that can work in proxy mode (without creating a VPN tunnel on your device). It usually supported by advanced VPN clients:

Hiddify, Shadowsocks, Nekobox, husi, Exclave, v2rayNG, Karing, Clash, WG Tunnel, Psiphon, Orbot, InviZible Pro, ByeByeDPI and many more.

Permissions

For the app to work properly, give it permission to run in the background (Alarms & reminders) and add both AutoGuard and your VPN app to AdGuard filtering exclusions.

Password

Allows this app to control the proxy settings of AdGuard. Go to Settings → General → Advanced → Automation. Enable it, copy the password and paste here. (How?)

Proxy

Open your VPN app, enable inbound SOCKS(4/5) or HTTP(S) proxy and enter its type and port here. (How?)
